name: Conductive Strike's Class Bonus On Hit pays 2 to put static counters on arcane objects
notes: Exercises the onHitAbilities macro (distinct from onAttackAbilities, used by emberslash-discard-draw -- this one fires after damage lands, not on declaration) plus a second, independent gate: Conductive Strike is ARCANE element, not NORM, and CanPlayerMeetCardElementRequirements checks GetPlayerEnabledElements() -> GetChampionLineage() (walks Subcards), a completely separate mechanism from the Counters['_overrides']['classes'] used for Class Bonus. The starting champion needs both patched: the classes override (WARRIOR, for the Class Bonus gate) and Subcards seeded with Lorraine, Arclight Saber (x9sSpjpP3G -- WARRIOR class AND ARCANE element, the deck's actual champion) for the element gate. Storm Slime (blqryebvwj, ARCANE ally) is seeded onto the field as the static-counter target. Conductive Strike is played from hand (2 reserve), declared as an attack (lands for its base 1 power -- the '+X where X = objects with static counters' dynamic buff is a computed value, correctly 0 before the trigger resolves), then the On Hit trigger offers to pay 2 more reserve; paying it calls AddStaticCountersToArcaneObjectsYouControl, asserted directly via Storm Slime's Counters.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Hit: You may pay (2). If you do, put a static counter on each arcane element object you control.
